Browser compiler provenance and source
Reviewed 2026-10-27

The pdfTeX WebAssembly binary and TeX package subset were copied from
https://github.com/sean-reid/latex-preview/tree/f80f84659c9476e41ef7212f6d753e10f6bd4af5/public
The integration project is MIT licensed; see latex-preview-MIT.txt.
The local JS runtime changes its default package endpoint to the self-hosted
texlive/ directory. The original two static-host compatibility changes are
described in swiftlatex.LICENSE.txt. The binary itself is unchanged.

The SwiftLaTeX repository declares AGPL-3.0 in its root LICENSE and README.
Its PdfTeXEngine API wrapper carries an additional EPL-2.0 OR GPL-2.0 WITH
Classpath-exception-2.0 header. Preserve both notices; the API wrapper's license
must not be assumed to replace the repository's license for the whole engine.
AGPL-3.0.txt accompanies this distribution. The integration project's earlier
swiftlatex.LICENSE.txt is retained as provenance, with this clarification.

Upstream source snapshot
https://github.com/SwiftLaTeX/SwiftLaTeX/tree/87dfb950eb9c8e9dcd4ee2a3ac97fbbbacfc618a
The complete source archive is supplied beside this notice as
upstream-source.tar.gz. It includes the original engine source, Makefile, and
license. Browser integration source is served directly as worker.js,
../thesis-compiler.js and ../thesis.js. The upstream source and the redistributed
runtime are separately pinned; the runtime provider supplies no reproducible
binary build attestation. checksums.json identifies the redistributed bytes.

TeX Live files retain their upstream licenses and notices. See
texlive-LICENSE.txt and the headers in the package files. The fixed package
subset uses LaTeX2e 2020-02-02 and SwiftLaTeX PDFTeX 0.3.0 (pdfTeX 1.40.21).
It is a compatibility-limited browser compiler, not a current full TeX Live
installation. Native TeX, Biber, arbitrary packages and binary figures require
a separately reviewed extension of the workspace.

None of these licenses or archives contains the user's private thesis files.
